name: Railway

evidence.paas: 03: hosted deployment platform; Railway runs the containers the customer builds from code or images

line: Deploy apps and databases together on a managed platform.

free.text: After trial: $1/mo credit; 1 project/3 services; new signups must pay

cells.regions: 4 compute regions; edge POPs route to them

work.math: $5 for data sent out, plus unmeasured CPU and RAM. The bill is the higher of the plan price ($5 Hobby, $20 Pro) or usage. Builds are free. Private Git and tax are unclear. Pro is recommended for business use.

100 GB sent out = $5. Requests (1 million × 100 ms of CPU) = $0.772. Idle CPU, RAM and memory over 730 hours are unknown. Bill: the higher of the plan ($5 Hobby, $20 Pro) or usage. Pro is recommended for business use.
Pro is needed for a 10 GB volume. Its $20 minimum applies against usage. Database compute and backup size are unknown. Private 10 GB database traffic is $0. Daily backups keep 6 days, not 7.
